newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 6.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 6.

text.p: -- Excel Communications Inc said it had a definitive agreement to acquire Telco Communications Group Inc for about $1.2 billion. Telco shareholders would receive 0.7595 share of the combined company and $15 cash for each Telco share. Excel shareholders would get one share in the combined company for each Excel share.
Excel closed at 18-7/8 Thursday and Telco closed at 22.

-- Storage Dimensions Inc said it expected second quarter results to fall below expectations because of near-term softness in the PC-LAN market, price erosion on disk drive components, below-plan staffing of its sales force, and product introduction expenses. It said it was projecting an unspecified loss. The First Call consensus estimate is a profit of $0.17 per share. Storage Dimensions closed at 10-1/4.

-- Eli Lilly and Co said results from trials of its new anti-osteoporosis drug raloxifene showed the drug increased bone mass while producing fewer side effects than estrogen replacement therapy. Lilly shares closed at 93-1/8.

-- Semiconductor maker SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV said its second quarter profit is likely to be within a range near first quarter earnings of $0.65 per share. The company also said it expected second quarter revenues to fall short of analysts' expectations. On the New York Stock Exchange its shares closed at 80-7/8, then tumbled to 73 in after-hours trading.
